Tomato___Late_blight.natural_cure: Bordeaux mixture (copper sulfate + lime). Remove infected plants. Apply wood ash around plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.precaution: Use resistant varieties. Avoid overhead watering. Monitor during cool wet weather.

Tomato___Early_blight.natural_cure: Neem oil spray (2ml/L every 7 days). Compost tea spray. Remove lower infected leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.precaution: Mulch soil. Rotate crops every 3 years. Stake plants for airflow.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.natural_cure: Copper soap spray. Hydrogen peroxide (3%) spray. Remove infected leaves.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.precaution: Use disease-free seeds. Avoid working with wet plants.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.natural_cure: Compost tea spray. Copper soap spray. Remove infected leaves immediately.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.precaution: Remove infected debris. Avoid wetting foliage. Stake plants.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Improve ventilation. Reduce humidity below 85%.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.precaution: Maintain humidity below 85%. Improve greenhouse ventilation.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Strong water spray to dislodge mites. Introduce predatory mites.

Tomato___Target_Spot.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Copper soap spray. Remove infected plant material.
Tomato___Target_Spot.precaution: Avoid overhead irrigation. 2-3 year crop rotation.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.natural_cure: Remove infected plants. Apply neem oil to control whitefly vector.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.precaution: Use virus-resistant varieties. Use reflective mulches to repel whitefly.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.natural_cure: Remove and burn infected plants. Wash hands before handling plants.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.precaution: Disinfect tools with 10% bleach. Use resistant varieties.

Tomato___healthy.natural_cure: No treatment needed. Preventive neem oil spray monthly.
Tomato___healthy.precaution: Regular monitoring. Proper nutrition and irrigation.

Potato___Late_blight.natural_cure: Bordeaux mixture. Wood ash. Remove and burn infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.precaution: Plant resistant varieties. Stop irrigation if detected.

Potato___Early_blight.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Compost tea. Remove infected lower leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.precaution: Use certified seed potatoes. 3-year crop rotation.

Potato___healthy.precaution: Certified seed potatoes and regular monitoring.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.natural_cure: Baking soda spray (1 tsp/L). Neem oil spray.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.natural_cure: Neem cake soil application. Trichoderma bio-fungicide.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.natural_cure: Trichoderma spray. Remove infected crop debris.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.precaution: Improve air circulation. Use resistant varieties.

Apple___Apple_scab.natural_cure: Lime sulfur spray during dormant season. Neem oil spray. Remove fallen leaves.
Apple___Apple_scab.precaution: Plant scab-resistant varieties. Apply dormant lime sulfur before bud break.

Apple___Black_rot.natural_cure: Bordeaux mixture spray. Remove mummified fruits. Apply compost tea.
Apple___Black_rot.precaution: Maintain orchard sanitation. Remove dead wood regularly.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Remove nearby cedar/juniper trees. Apply sulfur dust.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.precaution: Plant rust-resistant apple varieties. Create distance from cedar trees.

Apple___healthy.precaution: Maintain proper nutrition, irrigation, and regular monitoring.

Grape___Black_rot.natural_cure: Bordeaux mixture spray. Remove mummified fruits. Baking soda spray.
Grape___Black_rot.precaution: Vineyard sanitation. Prune for air circulation.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).natural_cure: No effective cure. Remove and burn infected vines. Apply wound protectant.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).precaution: Protect pruning wounds. Avoid large cuts.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.natural_cure: Copper sulfate spray. Neem oil. Bordeaux mixture.

Wheat___Leaf_rust.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Wood ash application.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.natural_cure: Copper soap spray. Garlic extract spray. Remove infected leaves.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.precaution: Use disease-free seeds. Work in dry conditions only.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.precaution: Maintain proper nutrition and air circulation.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.natural_cure: Neem oil spray. Compost tea. Remove infected leaves.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.precaution: Use disease-free plants. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.natural_cure: Baking soda spray. Milk spray (40% milk). Neem oil.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.precaution: Prune for open canopy. Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).natural_cure: No cure. Remove and burn infected trees. Apply neem oil to control psyllid.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).precaution: Certified disease-free nursery stock. Control Asian citrus psyllid.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.natural_cure: Copper soap spray. Garlic extract spray. Remove infected leaves.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.precaution: Plant resistant varieties. Apply copper sprays in autumn.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.natural_cure: Baking soda + neem oil spray. Milk spray (40% milk/60% water).
Squash___Powdery_mildew.precaution: Avoid dense planting. Water at base only.

Blueberry___healthy.precaution: Maintain acidic soil pH 4.5-5.5. Regular monitoring.
